scholarships.title: Roberta Sykes Scholarship
scholarships.degree: Doctoral Research, Postgraduate Coursework, Postgraduate Research

eligibility: Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander student
Postgraduate level: doctoral research, postgraduate coursework or postgraduate research
Study at a recognised overseas university
Must demonstrate a commitment to contributing to improving outcomes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities
existing.eligibility_summary: Open to Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students only, at doctoral research, postgraduate coursework or postgraduate research level, full time, in any area of study, at a recognised overseas university. Scholars must embody academic excellence and show a commitment to improving outcomes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities.
benefits: Supplementary financial assistance up to a maximum of AUD 75,000
Paid directly to the recipient in equal instalments at the start of each semester or term
Instalments are subject to academic progress
coverage: Supplementary financial assistance up to a maximum of AUD 75,000
Paid directly to the recipient in equal instalments at the start of each semester or term
Instalments are subject to academic progress
requirements: Must be enrolled full time at a recognised overseas university
Installments are released at the start of each semester or term and are subject to academic progress
application_method: Apply through the Aurora Indigenous Pathways Portal, which lists this scholarship with a More & apply function
Review the application criteria, dates and eligibility requirements published with the scholarship listing before submitting
existing.selection_notes: Roberta Sykes Scholars must embody academic excellence and demonstrate a commitment to contributing to improving outcomes for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities. On returning to Australia, scholars are strongly encouraged to give back to their communities. The portal separates this Scholarship type from the Roberta Sykes Fellowships for overseas research, the Roberta Sykes Executive Scholarship for short executive courses, and the Roberta Sykes Chief Executive Women Scholarship run with Chief Executive Women for the Harvard Kennedy School.
existing.best_fit: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Australians who already hold or are completing a first degree, have an offer or plan for full-time postgraduate study at a recognised overseas university, and can point to a record of academic excellence and community commitment.
existing.notes: The portal describes the award as supplementary financial assistance rather than a full cost-of-living scholarship, and it does not state that tuition fees are covered, so tuition coverage is recorded as false. Institutions named in the portal listing are Cambridge, Harvard, New York University, Oxford, University College London and an Other option for other recognised overseas universities. Aurora's international scholarships page lists a related Executive Scholarship worth up to AUD 20,000, Fellowships worth up to AUD 30,000, and a Chief Executive Women Scholarship for the Harvard Kennedy School.
existing.duration: Paid in equal instalments at the start of each semester or term, subject to academic progress
existing.application_period: Open 5 October 2026, closing 29 January 2027. The portal displayed the listing as not yet opened on 4 October 2026.
existing.program_type: Charitable foundation scholarship (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander postgraduate students, overseas study)
